terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: Static monumental landmark building, exterior shell only. No interior geometry: a prop kit is only ever looked at from outside, so an interior costs draw calls, geometries and VRAM for something nobody sees. Nothing moves, so one root pivot and zero sockets is the correct contract. The everyday Bangkok soi rental block: a six-storey cream render box, open at ground on square concrete columns for motorcycle parking with a small glass lobby at the -X front corner, a painted APARTMENT name across the first-floor beam, a 4 x 5 grid of identical recessed balconies on the +Z elevation (repeated on -Z), a vertical strip of six frosted stairwell windows on -X, outlined render panels on the blank walls and the parapet band, and six blue polyethylene tanks on the roof.

reasoning: The silhouette is a plain box on stilts; every bit of identity is in the REPEATED balcony module -- a recess with a pale-green railing, a sliding door, a condenser and laundry -- which the plate shows twenty times on one elevation and the registry notes say must be ONE instanced geometry per material.

Forty recesses are real holes through two facade extrusions, not panels stuck on a box: from any three-quarter view the reveal of each recess is what makes the grid read as balconies rather than as painted windows.

Three asymmetric features stop it reading as a mirrored box: the open colonnade on +Z and +X with a recessed lobby at the -X front corner, the six-window stairwell strip on -X, and the six blue tanks on the rear half of the roof.
Action readiness is minimal: static exterior shell, box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Forty balconies at five parts each is two hundred discrete parts; without instancing they are two hundred draw calls against a ceiling of 24. Ten InstancedMesh systems carry all of them plus the columns, windows and tanks at one submission each.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: a 4 x 5 grid of recessed balcony bays, each a real 1.10 m deep reveal through the facade
pale green steel railing of thirteen balusters across the front of every recess
aluminium sliding door on the left of each recess and a condenser with its pipe on the right
laundry rail with mixed garments on half the balconies
vertical strip of six six-pane frosted stairwell windows on the -X wall
six ribbed blue tanks in two tight rows on the rear-centre of the roof
open ground floor on square concrete columns with a recessed glass lobby at the -X front corner
APARTMENT painted across the first-floor beam, right of centre
grey rain-wash streaks hanging below every balcony and on the beam
outlined render panels on the blank walls and the parapet band, one per floor and column

resolvedUnknowns: The -Z elevation carries the same 4 x 5 balcony grid as +Z, over a solid ground floor; the plate shows one balcony elevation and the notes call for rooms on both sides of the corridor.
The +X wall is plain outlined render panels; the plate shows only its front corner.
The colonnade interior is a plain cream back wall 5.9 m behind the facade and a recessed lobby box; no motorcycles, no interior. This prop is an exterior shell.
The stairwell has six windows, one per floor including ground, as the plate shows; the proxy shows five because it dropped a floor.

preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 15.00 x 19.00 x 12.30 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=32000 triangles, <=24 draw calls, <=16 materials, <=32 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot and zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

pivotInventory.name: root
pivotInventory.justification: The ONLY mechanism this prop has. Static landmark geometry: nothing opens, turns or swings, so every part is fixed and gets no axis. A named pivot is a promise that a part turns on it.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.

colliderInventory.note: Declared on the asset as box. One convex proxy over the whole envelope; a level builder collides with the block, not with the colonnade bays separately.

actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

coordinateFrame.notes: Origin base-center as the asset declares, +Y up, balcony facade on +Z. The stairwell strip is on -X at z -1.70..-0.05 (4.45..6.10 m from the rear face on the proxy side map) and the lobby door faces -X from a cream box recessed 1.56 m behind the wall plane. The colonnade is open on +Z and +X; the -X wall is solid to the plinth for the rear 6.4 m and the -Z ground floor is solid.

silhouette.description: A 15.0 x 12.3 m box from a 0.25 m plinth to a 18.5 m parapet, on eleven 0.45 m columns under a 0.55 m beam whose top is at 4.15 m; five rows of four recessed bays 3.10 m wide on the +Z and -Z faces; six 1.24 m tanks to 19.0 m on the rear-centre of the roof. The silhouette events are the pilotis void at the base, the recess reveals, and the tank cluster over the parapet.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: Height is the primary axis at the declared 19.00 m: the tank caps. The Meshy v7 proxy of the plate normalises to w:h:d = 1 : 1.259 : 0.816, so w = 19.0 / 1.259 = 15.1 -> 15.00 and d = 15.0 x 0.816 = 12.2 -> 12.30; the plate agrees (front face ~500 px and side ~297 px against ~800 px of height at a ~35-degree three-quarter, which back-projects to w/h ~0.76 and d/w ~0.85). The list-time 20 x 14 was an eight-bay estimate and was corrected on the asset before the build, with the arithmetic in its notes. x spans -7.50..+7.50 (wall faces at 7.46 plus 0.03 m of panel groove and 0.01 of window frame), z spans -6.15..+6.15 the same way, y 0.00..19.00.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate normalises to w:h:d = 1 : 1.259 : 0.816 against the corrected declaration 1 : 1.267 : 0.820. Area-weighted band comparison gives mean |delta width| 0.013 and |delta depth| 0.008 of height across ten bands, the largest single residual being band 8 (the parapet) at -0.038, where the proxy carries a coping overhang this model does not. The proxy DROPPED a balcony row -- it shows four rows at a 3.25 m pitch over the same 4.15..17.05 span where the plate has five railing rows at a 111 px pitch -- so the row count is taken from the plate and the band placement from the proxy.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. The registry notes specify a double-loaded corridor with rooms either side, so the -Z elevation is authored as a second balcony grid identical to +Z over a solid ground floor. Confidence 0.60.
NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED beyond the front corner, where the plate shows the beam wrapping and the colonnade open. Authored as outlined render panels like -X without the stairwell strip.

componentTree.name: Rendered shell
componentTree.topologyRationale: Two facade extrusions with the forty recesses as REAL holes, an L-shaped -X wall extruded in the YZ plane, the +X wall, the body between, the parapet runs, the ground-floor core and lobby and every panel groove -- one render, ONE component and ONE draw call.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: A 15.0 x 12.3 m shell from the 0.25 m plinth to the 18.5 m parapet, beam 3.60..4.15, five rows of 3.10 x 1.98 m holes 1.10 m deep on +Z and -Z, and the pilotis void beneath +Z and +X.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: Facades butt the side walls' inner faces, the body butts the facades' backs, the core butts the body's underside, the deck sits on the body top; every joint is an opposed pair. Textureless: flat paint. The rain wash the plate shows under every balcony is delivered by the separate streak canvas quads, not by a texture set on this material.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. acceptance: Silhouette reads correctly without materials.
Quality contract has named all required macro feature groups before code generation.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Build the component hierarchy implied by the pre-spec complexity assessment.
acceptance: Macro, meso, and repeated structures meet qualityContract.minimumSpecDepth.
Parent-child relations, joints, seams, sockets, and contact points are explicit.
Every attached child appendage/connector has parentSocket, localStart/localEnd, contactType, embedDepth or overlap, and gapTolerance.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Refine shape, deformation, bevels, tapers, curves, asymmetry, and visible local geometry.
acceptance: Important visible forms are represented in component geometryDescriptor, deformations, localFeatures, or repetitionSystems.
Endpoint-based child parts are rooted at their attachment sockets and do not visibly float away from parents.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Match material color, roughness, bump, and local variation.
acceptance: Reference-derived albedo palette records dominant, secondary, and accent colors per visible material.
Each important material defines roughness variation and at least one normal/bump/displacement response.
Local material overrides, dirt/wear/stains/moss/chips/scratches or equivalent masks are tied to evidenceRefs.
Thin, transparent, reflective, wet, or fibrous materials document alpha/transmission/clearcoat/metalness/fiber response when relevant.
Generated preview uses procedural albedo/roughness/bump texture or vertex color variation instead of one flat color.
Generated preview uses independent PBR maps at 1024px or higher for the quality-first tier.
If source pixels are available, referencePbr extraction passed at confidence >= 0.7 or the pass is stopped/requesting better references.
Macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands are visible at the intended review distance without obvious tiling.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Add procedural surface locality such as normal/bump/displacement, AO, dirt, stains, chips, grain, moss, scratches, and wear.
acceptance: Every required material feature group has local overrides or surfaceDetail tied to evidenceRefs.
A grazing-angle close-up proves that normal/height detail breaks highlights naturally and does not read as smooth plastic.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make material and form readable under neutral turntable lighting plus optional reference lighting.
acceptance: lightingFromPhoto identifies key light direction/color/intensity, fill light, rim or environment light, and ambient color.
Exposure, tone mapping, background color/gradient, shadow softness, and contact shadow behavior are specified.
Lighting does not hide geometry/material gaps and screenshots can be compared fairly to the reference.
Neutral, grazing, and reference-matched lighting checks distinguish material errors from lighting errors.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make the model ready for future animation, transformation, physics, or destruction.
acceptance: Macro and movable meso components have stable pivot nodes.
Sockets, collider proxies, and destruction metadata are present for future runtime actions.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Protect runtime performance after visual fidelity is accepted.
acceptance: Triangle count, draw calls, instancing, LOD strategy, and FPS target are documented or verified.
Repeated detail is instanced or simplified where possible without breaking silhouette/material believability.

featureReviews.evidence: Four bays of 3.10 m between 0.60 m piers, five rows at 2.58 m from a beam top at 4.15, as forty real holes 1.10 m deep through two facade extrusions; a thirteen-baluster pale-green railing, a sliding door left, a condenser with its pipe right and a laundry rail in every one; garments of four sizes on twenty of them. Band table against the proxy: mean |delta width| 0.013 of height.
featureReviews.notes: Bay pitch, pier width and row pitch were read off the proxy's +Z depth map at 53.9 px/m rather than the plate, which foreshortens the front; the proxy dropped a row (four at 3.25 m) and the plate's five railing rows at a 111 px pitch decided the count. The first build's laundry was three equal navy/white/red panels and read as French flags; the garments are now four different widths and heights in muted tones with per-instance tints. The recess back walls carry a 0.63 linear vertex tint (the plate measures them at #ABA99D in shadow against #D4CDBD), which is what makes the grid read as recesses under the harness's flat light.

featureReviews.evidence: Open ground floor 0.25..3.60 on eleven 0.45 m columns under a 0.55 m beam that wraps the +X corner, a cream core wall 5.9 m back, a recessed lobby with a double glass door facing -X, and APARTMENT baked across the beam centred at x=1.5 -- right of centre, where the plate's word sits at 0.556 of the front width.
featureReviews.notes: The -X wall is solid to the plinth for the rear 6.4 m (proxy side map: x 5..350 px of 635) and open forward of it, which is where the plate's lobby door sits behind a corner column. The turntable gate passes with no enclosed background on any azimuth: the colonnade always shows the core or lobby wall behind it, never the backdrop. No motorcycles -- an exterior shell.

featureReviews.notes: The railing crop (#74786A) is bars mixed with the shadowed recess, so the bar tone was read off the bay zoom instead; the glass is authored above its measured #606453 so forty recessed panes clear the hole gate. The streaks were first drawn as 26 heavy smears per bay and read as a fringe; the plate has a few faint ones at the post bases, and that is what ships.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.90: silhouette 0.95 on a band table at 0.013 / 0.008 of height, structure 0.93 with every identity feature present at the plate's count and position, form 0.88, material 0.86 and lighting 0.86 held down by the flat harness light and the invented -Z / +X elevations. 27,904/32,000 triangles, 16/24 draw calls, 12/16 materials, 16/32 unique geometries.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the hero4x class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Six components and ten repetition systems: 16 of 24. The balcony module alone is five systems because an InstancedMesh takes one material and the module has five -- green steel, aluminium, glass, casing and cloth -- plus the streak quads as a sixth.

materials.note: wall covers the shell, beam, piers, recess walls, parapet, core and lobby -- one render for every rendered surface. Twelve of sixteen; three of them (sign, streak, cloth) are white bases that carry a post-construction canvas or vertex colour.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 27,904 of 32,000. The railings are 7,200 of it (fifteen boxes x forty instances) and the two facade extrusions with twenty holes each another ~3,000; the rest is the module hardware. Instancing means those 7,200 upload once.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Extrusions with holes for the facades, an extrusion in the YZ plane for the L-shaped side wall, boxes, a lathe for the tanks and a cylinder disc for the condenser grille. The recesses are holes in a Shape, not boxes subtracted or panels applied, so the shell has no interior coincidence at all.
Ten InstancedMesh systems carry 249 of the prop's 255 discrete parts: eleven columns, six windows (x2), six tanks and forty balcony modules at five systems plus the streaks.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.

Every material is declared textureless. Three post-construction canvases are assigned in the browser only: the APARTMENT lettering, the curtain stripes on the glass, and the rain-wash alpha under the balconies -- the documented printed-graphic route, none of them the five-canvas procedural set. Under Node the sign is cream, the glass flat and the streaks invisible.
